excerpt: Currently, Project 8 has finished a demonstration of this technique. ... Phase I ... Phase II we have made a measurement of the tritium spectrum using CRES. In Phase III we will demonstrate the ability to make CRES measurements in free space, as well as the ability to produce and trap atomic tritium. ... Currently, efforts are focused on Phase III. We are developing demonstrators of various technologies and working on our detector simulations and event analysis.
